items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Helen' multiple times (e.g., 'Well, Helen, I don't know', 'Because, Helen, when I used to say my prayers...'). There is no mention of a personal relationship with a third party named Helen Oakley.

ctx.x: Had he had a real change of heart, Cootie, or was he getting older and he thought differently then, or what was it?
Well, Helen, I don't know. My father was the type of man -- his was to get a dollar.
